## Kyoto Vegetarian 3-Day Trip Overview

A budget-friendly Kyoto plan for 2 adults, centered on temples, neighborhoods, and easy transit. I’m assuming mid-range local transport, simple vegetarian meals, and no paid guide or nightlife costs.

## 3-Day Itinerary, Transit, and Cost Plan

| Day | Focus | Transit Suggestions | Est. Cost (USD) | Est. Cost (JPY) |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| 1 | Higashiyama, Kiyomizu-dera, Gion | Subway/bus day pass + walking | $215 | ¥31,900 |
| 2 | Arashiyama, bamboo grove, river area | JR + local bus + walking | $245 | ¥36,300 |
| 3 | Fushimi Inari, central Kyoto, Nishiki Market area | JR/subway + walking | $195 | ¥28,900 |
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=| 3 | Fushimi Inari, central Kyoto, Nishiki Market area | JR/subway + walking | $195 | ¥28,900 |, Kyoto, Japan

### Day 1: Higashiyama Classics
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Start at Kiyomizu-dera, then walk down Sannenzaka and Ninenzaka for old Kyoto streets.
- Afternoon: Visit Yasaka Shrine and Maruyama Park, then continue to Gion for a relaxed stroll.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f8/A199_Japan_Kyoto_Maruyama_Park_Gion_Ar%C3%A9a_%284764445344%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Visit Yasaka Shrine and Maruyama Park, then continue to Gion for a relaxed stroll, Kyoto, Japan
- Dinner: Keep it simple near Gion or Kawaramachi and return by bus or taxi if tired.

Low-cost meal ideas:
- Lunch: tofu set meal at a shojin ryori casual spot, or a soba lunch set
- Dinner: vegetable ramen, curry rice with seasonal vegetables, or vegan donburi

Transit:
- Best fit: Kyoto City Bus + walking
- Budget tip: Use a one-day bus/subway pass only if you expect 3+ rides

Estimated cost breakdown for 2 adults:
- Transit: $18 / ¥2,700
- Attractions: $34 / ¥5,000
- Lunch: $44 / ¥6,500
- Dinner: $56 / ¥8,300
- Snacks/drinks: $19 / ¥2,800
- Buffer: $44 / ¥6,600

### Day 2: Arashiyama Nature Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Go early to Arashiyama Bamboo Grove and Tenryu-ji area before crowds build.
- Afternoon: Walk the river area, Togetsukyo Bridge, and nearby scenic paths.
- Dinner: Return to central Kyoto for a cheaper dinner than staying in Arashiyama.

Low-cost meal ideas:
- Lunch: yuba tofu bowl, vegetable udon, or onigiri + soup set
- Dinner: vegan curry shop, tempura vegetable set, or a local teishoku diner with veggie sides

Transit:
- Best fit: JR Sagano Line to Saga-Arashiyama, then walk
- Budget tip: Combine with a bus only if you add a distant stop like Otagi Nenbutsu-ji

Estimated cost breakdown for 2 adults:
- Transit: $20 / ¥3,000
- Attractions: $28 / ¥4,100
- Lunch: $42 / ¥6,200
- Dinner: $58 / ¥8,600
- Snacks/drinks: $17 / ¥2,500
- Buffer: $80 / ¥11,900

### Day 3: Fushimi Inari + Central Kyoto Food Walk
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Visit Fushimi Inari early for quieter paths and a shorter, easier climb.
- Afternoon: Head back to central Kyoto and browse the Nishiki Market area for vegetarian-friendly snacks and lunch options.
- Dinner: Finish with a low-cost Japanese set meal near Kyoto Station or Sanjo.

Low-cost meal ideas:
- Lunch: veggie sushi set, tofu skin rice bowl, or miso ramen with vegetable toppings
- Dinner: katsu-style vegetarian plate, udon set, or shojin ryori dinner special

Transit:
- Best fit: JR Nara Line to Inari Station, then subway/walking in central Kyoto
- Budget tip: Keep this day compact to avoid extra taxi costs

Estimated cost breakdown for 2 adults:
- Transit: $14 / ¥2,100
- Attractions: $18 / ¥2,700
- Lunch: $40 / ¥5,900
- Dinner: $54 / ¥8,000
- Snacks/drinks: $15 / ¥2,200
- Buffer: $54 / ¥8,000

## Budget Fit for 2 Adults

- Total estimated trip cost: **$655–$700**
- Total in yen: **¥97,100–¥103,100**
- Budget remaining from $900: **about $200–$245**

### What this budget comfortably covers
- 3 full sightseeing days
- Plenty of vegetarian meals
- Local transit and a small contingency
- Optional extras like one taxi ride, dessert stops, or a small souvenir budget

### Cost-control tips
- Stay near Kyoto Station, Gojo, or Kawaramachi for cheaper transit and food access.
- Choose lunch sets as your main meal and keep dinner lighter.
- Use walking-heavy routes in Higashiyama and Arashiyama to reduce bus use.
- Avoid peak-time taxis; Kyoto buses can be slow but are much cheaper.
